'''Actuator Restraint Cannon''', or '''A.R.C.''' was an electrical [[Stun cannon/Legends|stun cannon]] model used during the [[war against Zakuul]] by members of the [[GenoHaradan]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Actuator Restraint Cannon appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during "Chapter II: Run for the Shadows."

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
